text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Scarlet, how are you doing?"
"Is there anything troubling you?"...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm doing fine, don't worry!"
"Good luck with your work, Mom!" ...And send.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... This is fine, right...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll take a walk to clear my head.

All right!
Then this will be the last one, King-san!!
Actually, yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: During start practice, I ended up punching the starting gate before it opened~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you silly girl!
How many times must I tell you: "Exit the gate swiftly, yet elegantly"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! I kept telling myself that too, but as my fighting spirit began blazing, well... my fist just flew out!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... How typical of you.
...Yes, indeed. I suppose I must teach you in a way that truly resonates with you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned having a favorite line from that show you like, "Prifight," didn't you?
Let's see, "Pour your feelings into your fist"—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Pour your feelings into your fist and unleash them beyond the phantom realm"!
...I understand completely, King-san! In other words, I should pour my feelings into these legs!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
The 243rd Royal Meeting is hereby adjourned!
Until next time, wa~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san and King-san always talk like that together—
They really are on great terms...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Scarlet-san! Good day to you!
Could it be that you're interested in our Royal Meeting?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, I just couldn't help watching the two of you. Being able to talk about anything with each other is such a wonderful relationship.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! King-san can resolve any problem with a swift BAM-CRASH!
That is why I can consult her about anything!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No, Kawakami-san, you're amazing too! I mean—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Aren't you ever worried that "if I express how I really feel, they might hate me"—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thinking that way... I bet there are plenty of girls who can't summon the courage to express their true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my, sharing your true feelings is something that should surely delight the other party!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why is that...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Telling someone how you feel means wanting them to know about you... In other words!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It serves as a "signal of affection" that says, "I wish to become closer with you."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A signal... of affection...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed! The desire to get closer is something that will definitely make the other person happy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You convey your feelings, and then in turn they share their own feelings with you—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: By exchanging your thoughts like that, you can connect much, much more deeply with one another!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you express your feelings, you'll become closer, huh...
............

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
King-san and Kawakami-san were wonderful.
If only Mom and I could be like that, too—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...No, I *want* us to be like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted Daiwa Scarlet at the central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Wrote down the next date you're coming back right away in my planner."
"Can't wait to see you, Mom!" ...Alright, send.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm still a little anxious about talking to Mom about everything, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna show Mom my "signal of affection" loud and clear...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she said that, a strong sense of determination seemed to well up in Daiwa Scarlet's eyes.
